relationships.subject: α-ketoglutaric acid
relationships.evidence_quote: α-KG supplementation reduced the levels of IL-6, phosphorylated JAK2 and STAT3, and the nuclear translocation of p-STAT3 in IL-1β-induced degenerating NPCs.

relationships.subject: α-ketoglutaric acid
relationships.evidence_quote: The underlying mechanism may involve the inhibition of JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation and the reduction of IL-6 expression.

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: which could be explained by a blockage of the positive feedback control loop between IL-6 and JAK2/STAT3 pathway

key_findings: α-KG ameliorated IVDD in rats and NPC senescence, reducing IL-6 and p-JAK2/p-STAT3.
